in_sanskrit.name: अरायन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who flows as a protector

in_marathi.name: Arayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arayan is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Arya' meaning noble, virtuous, or pure. This name is associated with Lord Aryan, a revered deity in Hindu mythology, and is often given to boys as a mark of respect and devotion.
